@title.description: App title shown in the app bar and system UI.

@delete.description: Delete button in dialogs and menus.

@rename.description: Rename action in a session overflow menu.

common.maxReached: You can add up to {max} files

@validationIndicatingMinimum.description: Validation message when too few files are selected. {min} is the minimum.

setup.welcomeTitle: Your AI tutor that draws with you

@welcomeTitle.description: Headline on the first-launch welcome screen.

setup.welcomeBody: Draw on the shared board, talk out loud, and Texa will explain step by step — writing, drawing and pointing right on your work.
setup.privacyNote: Your board and voice are sent to Meta AI so the tutor can see and hear your work. Nothing is sent to Texa servers — there are none.

@privacyNote.description: Privacy note in setup and Settings.

@apiKeyLabel.description: Label for the API key field in setup and Settings.

@apiKeyHint.description: Placeholder in the API key field.

@testConnection.description: Button that checks the API key works.

@testing.description: Shown while the connection test runs.

@connectionOk.description: Success message after testing the API key.

setup.connectionFailed: That key did not work. Check it and try again.

@connectionFailed.description: Error after a failed connection test.

@micTitle.description: Heading for the microphone permission step.

setup.micBody: Texa listens so you can explain your thinking out loud. You can use Texa without the microphone, drawing and typing instead.

@skipMic.description: Button to continue without microphone permission.

@modelsTitle.description: Heading while on-device speech models download.

setup.modelsBody: Texa downloads its on-device voice models once. This can take a few minutes on a slow connection.

@modelsBody.description: Explanation on the model download screen.

@modelsReady.description: Shown when speech models are installed and verified.

setup.modelsFailed: Speech models could not be set up.

@modelsFailed.description: Error on the model download screen.

@downloading.description: Download progress. {name} is the model name, {percent} is 0-100.

home.title: Texa

@newSession.description: Primary button on Home. Opens the model picker and creates a session.

@emptyTitle.description: Empty-state heading when there are no sessions.

home.emptyBody: Create a session, draw your problem on the board, and talk Texa through it.

@deleteSessionTitle.description: Confirmation dialog title for deleting a session.

home.deleteSessionBody: Its board and history will be permanently deleted from this device.

@deleteSessionBody.description: Confirmation dialog body for deleting a session.

@sessionName.description: Text field label in the rename dialog.

@chooseModel.description: Heading in the model picker shown when creating a session.

home.chooseModelBody: This model will tutor this session. It cannot be changed later.

@modelNameLabel.description: Text field for typing a model name in the picker.

@loadModels.description: Button that fetches the model list from the API.

@createSession.description: Confirm button in the model picker.

@listening.description: Status pill when Texa is listening.

@capturing.description: Status pill while the student is speaking.

@thinking.description: Status pill while waiting for the AI reply.

@speaking.description: Status pill while Texa speaks and draws.

@muted.description: Status pill when the microphone is muted.

session.listenHint: I'm listening — tell me what you're doing

@stop.description: Button that stops AI speech and drawing.

@clearTitle.description: Confirmation title before clearing the board.

session.clearBody: Everything on the board will be erased. This cannot be undone.

@clearBody.description: Confirmation body before clearing the board.

@more.description: More button tooltip on compact layouts.

@retryTurn.description: Button that re-sends the last turn after a failure.

session.noHistory: Nothing here yet. Draw and ask your first question.

@selectFiles.description: Upload option: pick files from storage.

@logs.description: Section heading for local debug logs.
